meta_description: Nettio: know whether your laundry earns money, and on what.
review_not_found: This draft does not exist, or you may not decide it.
feedback_error: That did not work. Try again.
error_generic: That did not work. Try again.
perm_journal_read_body: See who did what in the app, agents included.
error_not_allowed: You are not allowed to do this. Ask the owner to grant it in “Team and rights”.
error_invalid_input: A value is not valid. Check the fields, then try again.
error_not_found: This item does not exist, or no longer. Reload the page.
error_amount: This amount is not valid: enter a whole number, no decimals.
error_already_set_up: The laundry is already set up: nothing changed. Change it in “Settings”.
error_not_set_up: The laundry is not set up yet. Begin with the start.
error_site_code_taken: This code already belongs to another site. Choose another: it prefixes deposit numbers.
error_site_plant_not_needed: This site processes laundry itself: it has no plant to send to. Remove the plant, or make it a counter.
error_site_plant_unknown: The chosen plant does not exist or does not process laundry. Choose a plant in use.
error_site_last_counter: At least one site must receive deposits. Keep this one in use, or open another first.
error_site_plant_in_use: Counters send their laundry to this plant. Attach them elsewhere before retiring it.
error_owner_keeps_everything: The owner keeps every right: this role cannot be changed.
error_route_not_for_this_nature: Only a workshop service has a route. Remove the steps, or choose the “workshop” nature.
error_route_step_unknown: A step of the route does not exist or is retired. Remove it from the route.
error_route_step_twice: A step appears twice in the route. Keep it once.
error_step_on_a_route: This step is on the route of a service in use. Remove it from that route first.
error_service_pricing_in_use: This service already has prices or packs: its pricing no longer changes. Create another service.
error_pack_service_wrong_mode: A pack in pieces only admits per-piece services, a pack by weight only per-kilo services.
perm_business_read_body: Read the sites, the catalogue, the prices and the diagram.
perm_settings_manage_body: Start the laundry, change its settings and its sites.
perm_staff_manage: Manage the team and its rights
perm_staff_manage_body: Give each person a role and tick what each role may do.
perm_catalog_manage_body: Change the services, their routes, the articles, the steps, the prices and the packs.
start_description: Three questions. Nettio prepares your sites, the usual workshop steps, four services with their routes and twelve articles. You can change everything afterwards.
profile_starting_hint: One site that receives and processes. Break-even is put forward.
profile_established_hint: One site that receives and processes, with a team.
profile_multi_site_hint: One plant, and counters that send it their laundry.
staffing_solo_hint: You hold every role: one screen, no validation to ask.
staffing_team_hint: Each person has a role and rights; sensitive gestures name their author.
start_site_description: Where your customers leave their laundry.
start_site_description_chain: Your first counter. Nettio also creates the plant it is attached to.
start_no_price: Nettio proposes no price: you will enter yours in the catalogue.
start_wait_title: The laundry is not set up yet
start_wait_body: Its owner must start it first. Come back afterwards: he will give you a role.
start_no_organization_title: Your account belongs to no organization
start_no_organization_body: Create your organization in Mon espace Kete, or ask your owner to invite you.
site_code_hint: One to three letters. It prefixes deposit numbers: A-0412.
site_plant_hint: The plant that processes what this counter receives.
sites_description: Where laundry is received, where it is processed, and which counter sends to which plant.
today_packs_without_service: {count} pack(s) with no service in use
today_no_role_body: The owner sees you in “Team and rights”: he must give you a role. Come back afterwards.
diagram_description: Drawn from your settings, redrawn at each change. Touch a site, a service or a step to set it.
flow_direct: From “received” to “ready”, with no workshop step
catalog_description: What you treat, what you do to it, through which steps, and at what price. A change never touches a past deposit.
catalog_no_service: No service. Add the first one.
catalog_no_article: No article. Add the first one.
catalog_no_step: No step. Add the first one.
catalog_no_pack_body: A pack is a fixed price for a quota of pieces or kilos. Nettio will tell you what each one earns you, on its real content.
service_active_hint: Retired, it stays on past deposits and leaves the counter.
route_add: Add a step to the route
route_remove: Remove the step from the route
price_never_proposed: Nettio never proposes a price: they are yours.
pack_services_hint: None ticked: every service of this mode is admitted.
team_description: Each person has a role; each role has rights, which you tick.
team_sites_hint: None ticked: she works at every site.
team_active_hint: Retired, the person no longer sees anything of the laundry.
team_invite_hint: To add someone: invite them to your organization from Mon espace Kete. At their first sign-in to Nettio, they appear here, waiting for a role.
team_rights_description: Choose a role, then tick what it may do. The change applies from the next action, on every screen, and to an agent acting for the person.
team_owner_all: The owner keeps every right: he cannot lock himself out.
settings_description: How your laundry works. These settings change no past deposit.
settings_counter_hint: The delays offered to the customer, express, and the discount an employee may grant alone.
settings_discount_ceiling_hint: Above it, the discount needs a person who has the right.
settings_dormant_days_hint: After that, it appears among the deposits to chase.
tracking_bag_hint: A deposit moves as one block per service: fast.
tracking_piece_hint: Each piece moves alone: precise, more gestures.
settings_costs_hint: What your costs and break-even are computed from. Nothing is estimated for you.
settings_labor_minute_cost: Cost of a minute of work (F CFA)
settings_labor_minute_cost_hint: The month’s wages divided by the minutes worked.
settings_labor_is_variable: The workshop is paid by the piece
settings_labor_is_variable_hint: Ticked: labor counts in each piece’s variable cost, not in fixed charges.
perm_customers_read_body: Read the name, phone and preferences of the laundry’s customers.
perm_customers_write_body: Create a customer, correct her name, phone, channel.
perm_orders_read_body: Read deposits, their content, state and history.
perm_orders_create_body: Record a deposit at the counter, with its real content.
perm_orders_cancel_body: Cancel a deposit that is not ready yet, with a reason.
perm_orders_discount: Grant a discount above the ceiling
perm_orders_discount_body: Exceed the discount anyone may grant alone.
perm_orders_release_unpaid_body: Hand over a deposit whose balance is not paid.
perm_payments_collect_body: Cash an advance or a balance, and hand a ready deposit over to its customer.
perm_payments_refund_body: Give money back on a deposit, with a reason.
perm_workshop_operate_body: Validate workshop steps, report an incident, mark a deposit ready.
settings_phone_prefix_hint: Added to numbers typed without a prefix: 228 for Togo.
counter_new_customer: Unknown number: a name is enough to create the customer.
counter_discount_above: This discount exceeds {ceiling} %: it needs a person who has the right. Lower it, or ask the manager to record the deposit.
counter_discount_above_yours: This discount exceeds {ceiling} %: you have the right, and it will be recorded under your name.
counter_no_site: None of your sites receives deposits. Ask the owner to give you one.
counter_no_price_body: The counter cannot sell anything until a price is entered. Add your prices in “Catalogue”.
customer_consent: Accepts the messages of her deposits
customer_consent_hint: Unticked: no message leaves for this customer any more.
customers_description: Found by name or phone. A customer is created at their first deposit.
customers_empty_body: They appear here from their first deposit.
orders_empty_body: Record the first one: it will appear here.
order_collect_paid: The deposit is paid: it can be handed over.
order_collect_unpaid_hint: You may hand over without settling: clear the amount. It will be recorded under your name.
order_confirm_cancel: Deposit {number} will be cancelled. This cannot be undone.
order_confirm_refund: {amount} will be given back on deposit {number}. This cannot be undone.
receipt_message: Hello {customer}. Deposit {number} received: {content}. Total {total}, paid {paid}, balance {balance}. Ready on {date}. — {business}
today_late: {count} deposit(s) promised and not ready yet
today_dormant_meta: Ready for longer than your delay
error_balance_due: {amount} is still due. Cash the balance, or ask a person who may hand over an unpaid deposit.
error_quantity_invalid: A quantity is not valid: a whole number of pieces, or a positive weight.
error_not_sold: A piece of the deposit has no price for this service. Add its price to the catalogue, or remove it.
error_discount_needs_reason: A discount needs a reason. Write it, then try again.
error_discount_above_ceiling: This discount exceeds the ceiling you may grant alone. Lower it, or ask the manager.
error_order_not_open: This deposit is no longer open: it is ready, collected or cancelled. Reload the page.
error_order_not_ready: This deposit is not ready yet: it cannot be handed over. Mark it ready first.
error_reason_needed: This gesture needs a reason. Write it, then try again.
error_refund_first: Money was cashed on this deposit. Refund it first, then cancel.
error_order_cancelled: This deposit is cancelled: it takes no more money.
error_payment_above_balance: This amount exceeds what is due. Enter the balance at most.
error_refund_above_paid: This amount exceeds what was paid. Enter that amount at most.
error_phone_invalid: This number is not a valid phone. Check it.
error_phone_taken: This number already belongs to another customer. Open their record, or correct the number.
error_customer_name_needed: This number is new: enter the customer’s name.
error_customer_needed: The deposit has no customer. Enter their phone.
error_site_does_not_receive: This site receives no deposits: it is a plant. Choose a counter.
error_not_your_site: You are not attached to this site. Choose one of yours, or ask the owner.
perm_cash_operate_body: Open one’s till, count it, close it, deposit at the bank.
perm_expenses_read_body: Read the month’s expenses and charges.
perm_expenses_write_body: Record an expense or a charge, void it with a reason, stop a recurring charge.
perm_draws_record_body: Note an owner’s draw: it is not an expense.
perm_money_read_body: See the result, costs, margins per pack, break-even, every till.
perm_costs_manage_body: Enter what each piece costs: minutes, consumables, machine.
till_description: Your till: its float, what came in, what went out, what it should hold. The gap is kept, never corrected.
till_none_body: Open yours with its float: cash will go into it by itself.
till_expected_how: Float + cash taken − refunds − expenses − draws − bank deposits.
till_counted_hint: Count first, enter afterwards: the expected amount is not corrected.
till_closed_right: Till closed: {counted} counted, it falls right.
till_closed_gap: Till closed: {counted} counted for {expected} expected. Gap: {gap}. It is kept as it is.
expenses_description: Everything that goes out: fixed or variable, one-off or every month. An error is voided with a reason, never erased.
expenses_fixed_hint: due even without a single deposit
expenses_empty_body: Add the first one: rent, wages, detergent, electricity.
behavior_fixed_hint: It falls due even with no deposit: rent, wages.
behavior_variable_hint: It rises with volume: detergent, electricity, hangers.
expenses_recurring_hint: It counts every month from its date, until you stop it.
expenses_stop_hint: Stopped, it still counts this month, then no more.
expenses_void_hint: Voided, it stays in the list, struck through, and counts nowhere.
expenses_void_confirm: “{label}” will be voided. This cannot be undone.
draws_description: What the owner takes for himself is not an expense of the laundry: it is noted apart, and deducted from what is left.
result_description: What you earn, and on what. Computed on cash really received: you can check it in your till.
break_even_sentence: You need to treat {month} pieces or kilos in the month to cover your fixed charges — {day} per working day. You are at {units}.
break_even_how: Fixed charges {fixed} ÷ what a piece leaves ({contribution}: it brings {revenue} on average and costs {cost} in variable costs), over {days} working days. The variable cost rests on {coverage} of the month’s pieces.
break_even_no_activity: No deposit this month: there is no break-even to compute yet.
break_even_no_sheet: No piece of this month has a cost sheet: break-even cannot be computed. Nothing is estimated for you.
break_even_no_contribution: A piece brings {revenue} on average and costs {cost} in variable costs: it leaves nothing to pay the fixed charges. At this level, no volume reaches break-even.
result_packs_description: Its price, minus the complete cost of its real content. A pack sold at a loss can be a choice: Nettio shows it, without judging.
result_no_pack_body: As soon as a deposit goes under a pack, its margin appears here.
result_below_cost: {count} deposit(s) this month went under the variable cost of their content. They are marked in their history.
result_reconciliation_description: What your sheets planned in variable costs for the volume treated, against your real variable expenses. The gap points to a wrong sheet or to waste.
result_planned_hint: by your sheets, on {coverage} of the pieces
result_real_hint: your variable expenses of the month
result_gap_under: you spend less than planned, or not everything is entered
result_how_cashed: Cashed = the month’s payments − refunds, every method together.
result_how_charges: Charges = the month’s expenses + running recurring charges. What you take is not a charge.
result_how_fixed: Fixed charges are spread over the month’s pieces in proportion to their minutes of work.
result_how_pack: A pack’s margin = its price − complete cost of the pieces it covered, on their real content.
result_how_never: A piece with no cost sheet has no cost: it is said “never measured”, never guessed.
costs_description: What each piece costs for each service: its minutes of work, its consumables, its machine. Measure at your place — weigh the detergent, time an ironing.
costs_missing: {count} piece(s) on sale have no cost sheet: their margin cannot be computed.
costs_no_price: Cost sheets are written for what you sell. Add your prices first.
costs_how_minutes: Complete cost = variable cost + share of the month’s fixed charges ({fixed}), spread over {minutes} minutes of work: {rate} F CFA a minute.
costs_how_units: Complete cost = variable cost + share of the month’s fixed charges ({fixed}), spread equally while no minute is known.
costs_labor_fixed: Labor counts in the fixed charges.
costs_labor_variable: The workshop is paid by the piece: {rate} F CFA a minute count in the variable cost.
costs_minutes_hint: Sorting, ironing, checking: time ten pieces, divide by ten.
costs_machine_hint: Electricity of a cycle, divided by the pieces of the cycle.
costs_origin: Where do these figures come from?
costs_measured_hint: Weighed, timed, read at your place.
costs_estimated_hint: An idea, to measure later: Nettio will say so beside every margin.
counter_below_cost: This deposit goes under its variable cost. You may record it: the owner will see it.
counter_below_cost_amount: This deposit goes under its variable cost ({cost}). You may record it: it will be marked in its history.
error_cash_session_needed: No till is open under your name at this site. Open your till in “Till”, or choose another payment method.
error_cash_session_open: You already have a till open at this site. Close it before opening another.
error_cash_session_closed: This till is already closed: its gap is kept as it is.
error_not_your_till: This till is not yours. Only its cashier, or a person who reads the money, may touch it.
error_cash_not_in_till: The till only holds {amount}. Enter that amount at most.
error_site_needed: Cash leaves a till at a site. Choose the site.
error_recurring_not_from_till: A recurring charge is not paid from the till. Choose the bank, Mobile Money or other.
error_stop_before_start: A charge cannot stop before it starts. Choose a date after its start.
result_pack_line: {sold} sold · price {price} · average cost of the content {cost}
